svg.desc: Ramses Square Development LOCATION Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Culture COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2015 2 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Winner of 1st prize in an urban design competition, this 930,000-square-meter Ramsis Square project in Downtown Cairo reimagines the space with greenery and pedestrian-friendly features. Commissioned by the Ministry of Culture, it includes architecture,landscape, transportation, environmental and social studies, and urban planning, with an estimated construction value of 2 billion EGP. BECT's scope included conceptual design and detailed drawings.
